about: Coastlines a North America search can reach whose countries are not in Geofabrik's North America extract: Cuba and the Bahamas within lat 20.5-27.5, lon -85.5 to -77.0 (Florida and the Yucatan; the western tip of Cuba is 214 km from Cancun), and Saint-Pierre and Miquelon (lat 46.6-47.3, lon -56.6 to -56.05). Fetched once from OpenStreetMap through Overpass (data of 2026-11-01T20:22:42Z) on 2026-11-01 and simplified to 500 m. OpenStreetMap data is available under the ODbL.
